acceptanceCriteria: widen and reap on a sealed store under 15 concurrent writers succeed or retry to success with no SNAPSHOT_MOVED terminal refusal.
JSG-V0-011 traced to tests; T2/T3 scenarios recorded.
body: PR #1415 (JSG lane, seal 2bd689f67) delivered V1-0887/V1-1512 partially; measured only under host load 20-35 (12 cores), so shape only. On a sealed (segmented) store under sustained appends, widen failed SNAPSHOT_MOVED 6/7 and reap 3/4. Until S6 lands, do not run journal seal on stores with widen/reap traffic.
title: Tasks journal S6 (JSG-V0-011): resume and prefix walk on segmented stores so widen/reap stop failing SNAPSHOT_MOVED on sealed stores
